adhesion|UW ZH AH N.why: The stressed vowel is IY, not UW, so the rimes differ.

attrition|UW ZH AH N.why: The stressed vowel is IH and the consonant is SH, so the rime does not match UW ZH AH N.

cohesion|UW ZH AH N.why: The stressed vowel is IY (hee), not UW, so the Rhyme Key is IY ZH AH N.

effusion|UW ZH AH N.reading: IH0 F Y UW1 ZH AH0 N
effusion|UW ZH AH N.why: Stress falls on UW followed by ZH AH N, the same key as fusion and infusion.

elusion|UW ZH AH N.reading: IH0 L UW1 ZH AH0 N
elusion|UW ZH AH N.why: It is pronounced like illusion, with stressed UW followed by ZH AH N.

evolution|UW ZH AH N.why: It ends in UW SH AH N, and SH differs from ZH.

perfusion|UW ZH AH N.reading: P ER0 F Y UW1 ZH AH0 N
perfusion|UW ZH AH N.why: It is said with ZH like fusion and infusion; the game's dictionary Z reading is a transcription slip.

reclusion|UW ZH AH N.reading: R IH0 K L UW1 ZH AH0 N
reclusion|UW ZH AH N.why: It is pronounced like seclusion and exclusion, with stressed UW followed by ZH AH N.

tradition|UW ZH AH N.why: The stressed vowel is IH and the consonant is SH, so it does not match UW ZH.

tuition|UW ZH AH N.why: The stressed vowel is IH and the consonant is SH, so the key is IH SH AH N.
